items.summary: Windows: hipStreamDestroy on a stream after hipDeviceReset corrupts the process heap (0xC0000374 / 0xC0000409, sometimes an unkillable hang) instead of returning an invalid-handle error; stale hipFree/hipEventDestroy are clean. Breaks FLAMEGPU teardown (util::cleanup then CUDASimulation dtor). 12-line repro in notes.

Windows: kernels launched on separate non-blocking streams run serially (4x1-block 20 ms kernels: 80.5 ms on 1 stream vs 81.3 ms on 4; GPU_MAX_HW_QUEUES no effect), on gfx1151/gfx1101/gfx1201. Fails FLAMEGPU's 11 TestCUDASimulationConcurrency tests, which pass on Linux. Repro in notes.
